summary: Correct the voice of the detransitive gloss
rationale: The only stem is detransitive žbīr/məžbər. Its example žbīr hano ... žġīl describes the householder being compelled to speak, and the supplied edition translates 'musste ... sprechen'. Active 'zwingen' reverses the role of the subject; 'gezwungen sein' describes the attested detransitive meaning.
